calibration.coordinate_origin: zero-based top-left; x right y down
calibration.joint_constraints: one common affine x and y calibration for every marker; independent visible-glyph center within native rectangle

observer.quantity: aliquot volume divided by collection duration; published interval-average outlet rate
observer.measurement_chain: aliquot weighed -> volume using approximately water density -> divided by sampling time -> published ordinate; exact Figure2 replicate reduction unspecified
observer.time_origin: first drop observed leaving bed (preprint p11)
observer.duration_support: thesis pp90/274 same-campaign method; exact Figure2 endpoints and replicate-specific timing not authenticated
observer.sequential_nonoverlap_support: successive collected aliquots with rate = volume/interval time; preprint pp10-11 and thesis p90; profile/replicate alignment remains unknown
observer.repetition_support: Figure1 reports means over 3-4 repetitions and sample SD; not a Figure2 pointwise membership/weight specification
observer.experimental_uncertainty: Figure2 has no identifiable experimental error bars; Figure1 bars are sample SD. Thesis general SD wording does not quantify Figure2 errors.
observer.density_approximation: thesis p274: approximately water (~1000 kg/m3) at same temperature; concentration-dependent 1-3% error, not independent symmetric reading uncertainty

pressure.within_run: fixed applied pressure supported by preprint pp4/10 and thesis p63 tank regulation; no time-resolved Figure2 bed-pressure record
pressure.node_reference: preprint applied overpressure; thesis regulated tank and separate pre-cell transducer, empty-cell correction; not established fixed bed drop
pressure.discrepancy: thesis pp90/273 selects tank pressure by grind/density; exact Figure2 per-condition pressure mapping unresolved

missing_facts: Figure2 pointwise replicate membership and fixed weights or exact aggregation operation
Exact collection endpoints and replicate alignment, abscissa-end/midpoint convention
Per-condition applied-pressure reconciliation and bed-pressure time histories/common pressure reference
Negligible storage/inertia and collected-volume mapping throughout compared intervals
Condition identity of LF triangular fragments and obscured glyphs; no hidden-point count
